item.title: Common Issues
item.description: Sensor Won’t Connect to Wi-Fi Symptoms: LED stays blue flashing, can’t complete setup Solutions: Ensure you’re using a 2.4GHz network (not 5GHz) Move closer to your Wi-Fi router Check that your Wi-Fi password is correct Restart your router and try again Many dual-band routers broadcast both frequencies with the same name. Try temporarily disabling 5GHz during setup. False Presence Detection Symptoms: Sensor reports presence when room is empty Solutions: Check for moving objects (fans, curtains, pets) Reduce sensitivity in app settings Ensure sensor isn’t pointing at windows or reflective surfaces Run manual calibration with room empty No Presence Detection Symptoms: Sensor doesn’t detect when someone is present

item.title: Setup
item.description: Initial Setup Power on the sensor using the included USB-C adapter Open the OpticWorks app on your phone Tap “Add Device” and select “Bed Presence Sensor” Follow the in-app instructions to connect to Wi-Fi Placement For bed monitoring, position the sensor: Under the bed or on a nightstand Pointed toward the center of the mattress 50-100cm from the edge of the bed The sensor works through mattresses and bedding. No direct line of sight to the person is required.

item.title: Unboxing
item.description: What’s in the Box Your OpticWorks package includes everything you need to get started: Presence Sensor - The main sensing unit Power Adapter - USB-C power supply (5V/2A) Mounting Hardware - Screws and adhesive pad for installation Quick Start Guide - Printed setup instructions Before You Begin Check that all items are present Inspect the sensor for any damage Download the OpticWorks app (iOS/Android) Ensure you have a 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network available The sensor requires a 2.

item.title: Calibration
item.description: Why Calibrate? Calibration helps the sensor understand your specific environment: Room size and shape Bed position and height Typical movements vs. presence Automatic Calibration The sensor automatically calibrates during the first 24 hours: Leave the room empty for 30 minutes after setup The sensor will establish a baseline Normal use will refine detection over time Manual Calibration If detection is inaccurate, you can trigger manual calibration: Open the OpticWorks app Go to Device Settings → Calibration Select Start Calibration Follow the on-screen prompts: Empty room for 2 minutes Lie in bed for 2 minutes Exit the room Sensitivity Adjustment Fine-tune detection sensitivity in the app:

item.title: Installation
item.description: Choosing a Location For optimal performance, place your sensor: 1-2 meters from the monitoring area Elevated position (1-1.5m from floor) Clear line of sight to the target area Away from heat sources and direct sunlight Mounting Options Wall Mount Use the included screws or adhesive pad Position the sensor at a 15-30° downward angle Ensure the USB-C port is accessible Tabletop Placement Place on a stable, flat surface Use the rubber feet to prevent sliding Angle toward the monitoring area Power Connection Connect the USB-C cable to the sensor Plug the power adapter into a wall outlet The LED will flash blue during startup Do not use extension cords or power strips that may cause voltage fluctuations.
